title: Keep task records tidy in core's active contract
goal: Vision: V-13. CEO directive 2026-11-16: agents must keep task records tidy. Core now keeps one active contract and updates it in place instead of adding numbered mandates (17cdfe427), so the rule goes into AGENTS.md item 9 and the self-build contract item 9 (no net line in core), pinned by architecture_tests. The commercial repository records it as Mandate 88 with tasks retire and tasks tidy (its T-AGENTCLAUDETASKTIDY-1).

reuse.searched: Core's active contract (AGENTS.md) and self-build contract as rewritten by 17cdfe427, its governance tests, and the commercial tool's tasks retire and tasks tidy. Text and tests only in core.

limitations: Core holds the rule as contract text; the tooling that reports and retires is in the commercial repository.
The self-build clause was folded into item 9 with no net line added to core (Mandate 84).
